description: This file defines the OrganizationsClient class for AWS SDK in PHP, which provides methods to interact with AWS Organizations service. It primarily uses PHPDoc annotations to describe available API methods, both synchronous and asynchronous, for managing organizations, accounts, policies, and related entities.
